description.text: Program Introduction: Medical Laboratory Tests and Analyses is a specimen of the patient's blood, body fluid, secretions, or exfoliative cells to make a test to obtain the data of pathogenic, pathological changes and organ function, and its specialty is the specialized subject of methods, principles and results analysis. The major mainly study basic knowledge of basic medicine, clinical medicine and medical examination. They were trained by the medical test operation skills system and had the basic ability of clinical medical examination and health inspection. Requirments: 1. Master basic theoretical knowledge of basic medicine and clinical medicine; 2. Master the basic theories and techniques of medical chemistry, molecular biology, immunology, pathogenic diagnostics and blood cell morphology, and understand the basic components and properties of the commonly used inspection instruments; 3. Having the basic ability of mathematical statistics and computer application; 4. Be familiar with the principles, policies and regulations related to national health work and main management of clinical trials; 5. Understand the development trend of theory and technology of medical laboratory frontier science; 6. Mastering the basic methods of literature retrieval and data investigation, and have certain scientific research and practical working ability. Future career: Students can work in medical inspection and medical laboratories at all levels of hospitals, medical research institutions, blood stations, disease control centers, R & D and production of extracorporeal diagnostic reagents, commodity inspection, environmental protection, customs quarantine and other departments.

duration.text: The Medical Laboratory Tests and Analyses at Dalian Medical University is a 5 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5555 USD/per year ￥ 40000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graducation Certificate of High school Graduation Certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 4.Academic transcript of high school 5. Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport (Liaoning) For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper

requirements.text: 1.Applicant should be between 18 and 25 2.Applicant should hold high school graduation or equivalent to a Chinese high school graduate
